Code/technical comparison format established by "before/after" structure, expecting a parallel second line showing a corrected or alternative version of a CSS/HTML-like directive or tag.

The pattern "panel\npanel" suggests a before/after contrast of a code element, likely showing a syntax change, typo, or formatting difference in a technical or markup context.

"  panel " is the second line's start, with a space suggesting indentation or a new variant; next tokens likely complete a command, class name, or keyword continuation (e.g., "panel_" or a colon/keyword).
"
panel:  //  error
The panel  " — the second line "panel " likely continues with a different word, punctuation, or code fragment showing a contrast.
"panel " suggests a new, possibly abbreviated or renamed version of the directive.</explanation>
